---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A short, clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve? What's the current pain point or limitation?

## Proposed Solution

How would you like this to work? Include any command names, flags, or behaviour changes you have in mind.

## Alternatives Considered

Any other approaches you considered and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional Context

Links, screenshots, related issues, or any other context that would help.
